# ethereum-optimism/optimism Daily Update (May 26, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's development focused on enhancing Supernode functionality with WAL canonical payloads and addressing several critical bug fixes across `op-reth` and `op-node`. Significant refactoring in `kona/service` improved testability, and documentation for Upgrade 19 was updated.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Supernode Enhancements and Stability
The Supernode received significant updates, including the implementation of WAL canonical payloads for rewind and invalidate operations, improving its robustness during state changes ([#21015](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21015)). Further stability was added by fixing WAL reset rewind payloads ([#21040](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21040)) and enabling retries for `RewindEngine` on `DeadlineExceeded` errors ([#21023](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21023)).

### `op-reth` and `op-node` Bug Fixes
Several critical bugs were addressed in `op-reth` and `op-node`. `op-reth` now clamps `sync_target` past `best_block` in `advance_sync` to mitigate mmap/ftruncate race conditions ([#21012](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21012)) and uses `RoInconsistent` for `op_proofs` CLI subcommands to prevent failures with inconsistent static files ([#21008](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21008)). `op-node` fixed a stall during EL sync when consolidating on `NotFound` errors ([#21004](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21004)).

### Contracts and Tooling Improvements
The `contracts-bedrock` package was updated to scale `ResourceConfig` for smaller `gasLimits` in `v7.0.0` ([#20925](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20925)). The `check-karst` tool now includes EIP-7934 and EIP-7825-deposit checks ([#21027](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21027)). CI issues related to Rust nightly bumps ([#20918](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20918)) and semver checks ([#21029](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21029)) were also resolved.

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- **Dependency Updates:** Multiple `gomod` dependencies were bumped, including `github.com/Masterminds/semver/v3` ([#21048](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21048)), `go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace` ([#21022](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21022)), `go.opentelemetry.io/otel` ([#21021](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21021)), `github.com/coder/websocket` ([#21020](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21020)), `golang.org/x/crypto` ([#21019](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21019)), `github.com/btcsuite/btcd/chaincfg/chainhash` ([#21018](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21018)), `github.com/kurtosis-tech/kurtosis/api/golang` ([#21017](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21017)), and `github.com/BurntSushi/toml` ([#21016](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21016)).
- **Feature Development:** New features include `op-rbuilder` and `rollup-boost` flashblocks support ([#21044](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21044)), a `PostExec` replay debug API ([#21043](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21043)), consensus, node, and production gating ([#21042](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21042)), `kona` validation of SDM `PostExec` in native single-chain proofs ([#21034](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21034)), and setting `op-node`'s default `syncmode.offset-el-safe` to 12h ([#21033](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21033)).
- **Documentation and Chore:** Updates include removing `rust/kona/version.json` ([#21046](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21046)), updating SCR dependency for `op-contracts/v7.0.0-rc.4` ([#21045](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21045)), deprecation pass on `op-geth` documentation ([#21037](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21037)), and adding per-component release pages to docs.optimism.io ([#21035](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21035)).
- **Bug Fixes and Tests:** A fix for `op-supernode/interop` to prevent `FinalizedL2` from regressing to genesis across activation ([#21028](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21028)) and a new `check-glamsterdam` CLI with shared loops for acceptance tests ([#21025](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21025)) were opened. `op-program` will now include required gas in L1 precompile cache keys ([#21024](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21024)).

## CLOSED ISSUES
- **Acceptance Testing for Light CL Sequencing:** The issue to add a test with a light CL as a sequencing node ([#19389](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19389)) was closed, indicating successful implementation and testing of this configuration.

## NEW ISSUES
- **Contracts Bedrock Nondeterminism:** A bug was reported where `semver-lock` generation can be nondeterministic for duplicate compiler-profile artifacts, specifically affecting `L2ProxyAdmin` ([#21032](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21032)).
- **`op-reth` RPC Forwarding:** The `eth_getBlockReceipts` method is missing from the list of forwarded RPCs for the historical endpoint in `op-reth` ([#21031](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21031)).
- **SuperZKDG Design Document Update:** An issue was created to update the design document for SuperZKDG ([#21038](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21038)).
- **Flaky Test Regression:** The `TestUnsafeChainNotStalling_CLSync` test family is regressing again after a previous fix, indicating a potential underlying issue ([#21041](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21041)).

## ACTIVE ISSUES
- **`op-supernode`: Track FCU retry-verify workaround in RewindToTimestamp** ([#19772](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19772)): The discussion indicates that the team has accepted living with the current workaround due to the upstream PR being closed as stale and a lack of interest in fixing reth's engine API for synchronous results.
- **[L2CM] Investigate adding an array of predeploys to increase upgrade safety** ([#19260](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19260)): This issue was reopened because a TODO referencing it still exists in the codebase, specifically in `L2ContractsManager.t.sol`. The TODO highlights the need for a single source of truth for predeploys. The discussion emphasizes that if the remaining work is out of scope, the TODO should be removed or repointed to a follow-up issue before closing.
- **L2CM: prevent silent drift between feature flag definitions and CI matrix** ([#20340](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20340)): The decision was made to handle this by documenting all places that need updates when adding new dev features or system features. This documentation will be added as comments in `DevFeatures.sol` and `devFeatures.go`.
- **bug(op-reth): proofs-history exex SIGBUS crash and infinite retry loop during deep FCU rewinds** ([#20934](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20934)): The latest comments indicate that a PR was raised for fixes related to aggressive retrying and log flooding, but the SIGBUS crash is still under investigation. A hypothesis suggests a possible SIGBUS race during unwind/reorg flows due to `File::set_len(ftruncate)` truncating static-file mmap pages while another thread is reading them. An issue has been opened on Reth for this.
